name: Global Congress on Neurology & Neuroscience
theme_primary: The Connected Brain: Advancing Neuroscience, Neurology, and Patient Care
theme_blurb: The Connected Brain: Advancing Neuroscience, Neurology, and Patient Care — where bench discoveries become bedside therapies for the world's most complex organ.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening neurologists, neuroscientists and industry leaders at the forefront of brain science.
about_heading: Where neuroscience meets the next decade.
about_lead: GCNN 2027 is a global forum for pioneering research, clinical translation and cross-disciplinary dialogue across the full spectrum of neurology and neuroscience.
about_body: Across two days of keynotes, parallel technical tracks, poster sessions and focused workshops, we convene the brightest minds to chart the frontier of brain science — from molecular mechanisms to clinical impact.
